gaps.sentence: The flood wiped ___ the entire harvest.
The ministry tried to play ___ the incident.
gaps.explanation: play down = make something seem less important (opposite: play up).
pick up = learn without formal study; also collect (pick somebody up).

gaps.sentence: The caterpillar will turn ___ a butterfly.
The new stadium made ___ an impressive sight.
gaps.explanation: make for = produce a particular result (make for a good atmosphere); also move towards.

gaps.sentence: I ran ___ my old teacher at the airport.
gaps.explanation: run into somebody = meet them by chance (also: bump into).

gaps.sentence: We need to iron ___ a few details before signing.
